 "id": "sc-cleanhouse-quiet",
 "briefing": [
  "Clean House, quiet raid. Take the phone upstairs and leave without a fight.",
  "The way out stays shut until you hold the phone.",
  "If they raise the alarm, help arrives from the north and you have four minutes."
 ],
 "squad": [
  1,
  4
 ],
 "minutes": 15,
 "scene": "",
 "navFile": "suburbv2.bytes",
 "seed": 0,
 "notes": [
  "Pacing: quiet. Few enemies, one yard patrol, no timer until somebody is seen. Play it in a find-intel mission so that the phone is there.",
  "Completion: take the phone (trigger 1 'Phone taken'), which opens the extraction, then extract. Failure: four minutes after the alarm (trigger 3 'Too late') the mission fails; everyone dead also ends it, as in the game.",
  "Alarm (trigger 2): two patrols from the north come and hunt the nearest player. Nothing on the way out depends on the alarm or on any roll.",
  "Optional content: the wanderer outside the house at (-25, 14) is there one mission in two (chance 50). The mission plays the same without him.",
  "Minutes and squad are the author's estimate; no playtest has measured them yet."
 ],

  {
   "id": 1,

   "facePlayer": true,
   "hunt": true,
   "red": true,
   "message": "They know you are here. More are coming from the north: four minutes."
  },

   "delay": 240,

   "message": "Too late: their help has the house.",

  }
 ],
